A '''Nightsister dagger''' was a traditional, bladed weapon of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was commonly used by the clan led by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Nightsisters" />
